name: ikigai-book-a11y-axe
description: The books' axe-core instruments: over a jsdom of every built page with the scripts run (a11y/axe.mjs), and in a real browser over the assembled site in every theme, with the kernels loaded (a11y/axe-browser.mjs).

scripts.check: for book in ../books/*/book; do node axe.mjs "$book" || exit 1; done
